purpose: Evaluate the manner or extent of someone’s action.
keywords: Vます stem + ぶり / っぷり; N + ぶり
I admire the way he works.
Her calm way of speaking stayed with me.
formation: Vます stem + ぶり / っぷり; N + ぶり
restrictions: This entry concerns manner, not the elapsed-time use of ぶり.
mistake: Use the stem: 働きぶり, not 働くぶり.
